Commentary.Commentary: Terrific bowling performance by the Australians. Barring Cook's battling ton and a brief defiance from Amla, none of the Protea batsmen applied themselves. Starc and Lyon were the pick of the bowlers while Hazlewood and Bird were very tidy as well. A well-rounded bowling effort and it's set them up for a consolation win. Can SA trigger some nerves with early wickets? The chase isn't far away.

OUT! Gone! What a ball to bowl to a centurion!  Beautiful inswinger on off, gets through Cook's defences to disturb the timber. Special delivery to end what has been a special innings regardless of the method employed. AUSTRALIA NEED 127 RUNS TO WIN.
Fullish on off, tails in as Cook gets a thick inside edge on to the front pad.
Full and swinging in from around off, Shamsi blocks it with the inside half to the leg side.
Debutant TABRAIZ SHAMSI is the last man in.

OUT! RABADA DEPARTS! Shortish around leg stump, Rabada swivels to pull as it goes down the leg side. Wade dives to his right to take a good catch. Rabada has got some glove on that and up goes the umpire's finger. Another wicket for Hazlewood and the Aussies are close to wrapping this up. Lead is now 126.
Length ball just outside off, Rabada lets it pass.
Good length outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, shaping away, Cook chases it but is beaten by the away movement.
Full and tailing in from off stump, Cook bunts it towards mid on.
Fullish on off, well blocked off the front foot.

FOUR! Full and on the pads, Rabada gets a faint tickle on it. Wade puts in a big dive to his right but cannot get to it as the ball races to the fence. Runs trickling for the Proteas but it's coming for them. Lead is 125 now.
Good length outside off, shapes away late to beat Rabada past the outside edge.

Very full and swinging away from outside off, Rabada looks to drive as the ball zips through to Wade. Stifled lbw appeal albeit without much confidence from the Aussies for caught behind. Turned down by the umpire. No bat involved there.
Length ball speared wider outside off, no shot offered.
Good length outside off, shaping away, left alone to the keeper.
Drinks break....
2nd Test ton for Cook.

FOUR! THERE'S THE MILESTONE! Top innings it has been. Short of a length on middle, Cook swivels and drags the pull through square leg. The fielder in the deep doesn't make a great attempt, deliberately to have the opener off strike for the next over. Nevertheless, SA will take the bonus runs. Lead is now 121.
Full ball outside off, Rabada leans into it and drives it sweetly through the covers. Sublimely timed but Warner does well to put in a sliding stop near the ropes. Three runs taken.
Good length around off, whipped away off the back foot to deep square leg for a single. Moves to 99.
Fuller on middle and leg, Cook shuffles to flick but cannot beat mid on.
Fuller ball outside off, Cook creams it through the covers for a couple.
Good length around leg stump, looks to flick but misses.
KYLE ABBOTT walks out to bat.

OUT! STARC NAILS IT! A typical wicket for him this is as the full inswinger tails in from middle to rap Philander on the front pad. The lbw appeal is given instantly by the umpire. Philander decides to try his luck with the review. No bat involved and Hawk Eye shows it crashing into middle and leg. Cook is running out of partners. The lead is 111.
Philander has been given out lbw. He decides to review it. Looks plumb unless there is an inside edge which looks unlikely. Let's see.
Very full outside off, Cook stays still and pushes it firmly past mid off. Won't make the fence but they'll get three. He inches closer to the magical three-figure mark.
Four Leg byes! More handy runs! Good length around leg stump, Cook misses the flick as it brushes off the pads. Beats a diving Wade down the leg side en route to the fence.
Good length around off, nips in a touch, worked towards mid-wicket.
Good length on middle, nips back sharply to rap Cook on the thigh pad.
Back of a length around off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
FOUR! Too straight from Hazlewood and this time Philander puts it away with a nice flick through mid-wicket. Finds the fence and these are valuable runs for SA.
Another play and a miss! This should be frustrating Hazlewood. Full ball outside off, swing away late as Philander is beaten on the drive.
Good length outside off, width and Philander looks to flash at it. The slight away movement beats the edge.
Length ball wider outside off, Philander goes after it but it moves further away sharply to beat the bat by a mile.
Good length closer to off, blocked well from the crease to the off side.
What a ripper to start off! Length ball around off, kicks up off the deck to whiz past the outside edge. Movement as well and Philander had no clue at all.
The second new ball has been taken straightaway. Josh Hazlewood to take it.
Fullish on middle and off, wristed away powerfully to mid on for a single. LEAD IS 100 NOW. The second new ball is now available.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Full on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Full and around off, Philander pushes it towards the bowler who parries it to silly mid off.
Fullish on off, shuffles across and pushes it towards mid on.
Good length just outside off, nips back in late as Philander lets it pass. That wasn't far away from the off pole.
Good length around off, Philander leans forward and pushes it to mid on for a single.
Full and tailing in from around off, Philander pushes at it but gets it off the thick inside edge to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, blocked off the front foot towards mid off.
Length ball angled in on off, defended solidly from the crease to mid on.
Fuller and swinging into middle and leg stump, Cook clips it towards square leg for a run.
Good length outside off, punched off the back foot past cover for a brace.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD comes on to bowl.
Fuller outside off, Philander bunts it straight back to the bowler.
Shortish outside off, slapped off the back foot to point where Lyon puts in a slide. Single taken.
Good length just outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Good length outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot to cover.
Fuller and around off, pushed off the front foot to cover.
Fuller and shaping in from around off, Cook gets his bat down in time to chop it to mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, blocked well off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller outside off, steps out and drills it to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Cook presses forward and blocks it out.
Loopy outside off, Cook shuffles across and works it with the turn to short leg.
Drifting in on middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a brace.
Floated on a length on leg stump, worked behind square for a single.
Length ball outside off, Cook pushes at it but gets an edge that just goes past gully for a brace.
Short cover goes to short mid-wicket.
Good length on middle and leg, worked to square leg for a single.

DROPPED! Tough chance though. Full ball outside off, Philander cannot keep the drive down as it goes towards Bird. He sticks out his left hand but isn't able to hold on to it. These are reflex catches and you cannot blame the bowler really. Bird will be disappointed though.
Fuller and tailing in from around off, pushed firmly to mid on where Starc makes a good stop.
Length ball around off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Good length around off, nips in sharply off the seam. Philander gets a faint inside edge on the pads.
Floated on a length on leg stump, worked off the back foot just behind short leg. He wasn't in control due to the bounce.
Flighted outside off, bounces extra with inward turn to hit Philander on the glove. Doesn't carry to short leg. Good bowling.
Switches to over the wicket.
Floated on middle and leg, flicks it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, defended off the front foot on to the track.
Floated on a length on leg stump, worked off the back foot just past short leg for a run.
Slips it down the leg side, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Good length outside off, Philander doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through wide mid on for a brace.
FOUR! STREAKY RUNS! Full and outside off, Philander goes for the big drive but gets a thick edge that flies between the slips and gully to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, pushed gently towards point.
VERNON PHILANDER comes out to bat.

OUT! BOWLING CHANGE WORKS! What a huge wicket! Length ball angling away on middle and leg, straightens ever so slightly to rap de Kock on the pads. Loud lbw appeal but not given by the umpire. Smith decides to review this. Looked very plumb but where was it pitching? No bat involved on it. Hawk Eye shows it's pitching in line and hitting middle and off. De Kock has to go and this is a huge blow to the tourists. Lead is now 77.
JACKSON BIRD comes on to bowl.
Fuller on middle and leg, pushed to mid on for a single.
Floated on a length on off, de Kock goes back to pull but gets an inside edge on to the back leg. He is getting looking very nervy out there, trying to put pressure on the bowler.
Drops it short outside off, de Kock sits back and cuts it but straight to cover.
Drifting in on middle and leg, shuffles to pull but is struck on the thigh.
Flighted around off, de Kock looks to drive but gets an inside edge on to the boot.
On a length around off, de Kock makes room and slaps it to cover.
Another bouncer around off, Cook sways away from the bumper.
Short ball on off, Cook evades the bumper just in time.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one. Almost played inside the line there.
Length ball on middle and leg, Cook shuffles and clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length on middle and leg, Cook works it to the leg side.
Goes past the edge! Back of a length outside off, tentative poke from Cook.
Floated outside off, de Kock makes room and punches it but straight to cover.
That was close! Floated on a length around off, extra bounce and lobs off de Kock's glove just wide of slip.
Fuller on the pads, worked away to the leg side.
Floated on off, de Kock steps out for the big shot but adjusts to tap it to the covers.
Floated around off, defends it well from the crease.

FOUR! Not if he's going to bowl like this. Half-tracker on off, de Kock goes back to that one and pulls it hard to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary. Positive intent from the southpaw straightaway.
NATHAN LYON to bowl from the other end. He got ripping turn yesterday in the dying stages of the day. That was under lights though. Let's see if he gets turn straightaway.
Short ball to end the over. Cook ducks under the bumper.
Fullish on off, Cook pushes at it as the ball goes off the outer half towards the off side.
Back of a length on leg stump, Cook rides the bounce and tucks it towards short leg.
Shortish on middle and leg, better from Cook this time as it is blocked off the back foot.
Dug in short on middle and leg, rises on Cook who looks to fend but is hit on the glove. Falls to the ground safely much to his happiness.
Good length angled in from well outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Over to the cricket then, Stephen Cook is on strike and it shall be Mitchell Starc to start proceedings on day 4. Here we go!

The players and umpires are out there in the middle. Everyone is wearing black armbands in memory of the late Philip Hughes who passed away on this date two years back. Definitely an emotional day for the Australians. They will want to win this Test to pay tribute to their former teammate. The visiting batsmen have allowed the fielding side to come out first in respect of the situation. Sporting behavior indeed.

Hello and welcome folks to the fourth day's play. After being dominated in the first two games, the hosts are finally at the brink of nailing a Test match. The game isn't still over though as batting last is never easy especially when there is a night session to contend with. If South Africa can eke out a lead in excess of 175, things could get tricky under lights. Australia will therefore want to wrap up things quickly. Massive first session coming up. Join us in a while for the start of play.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 1.....

South Africa lead by just 70 with four wickets in the tank. Although they are currently staring down the barrel, one partnership could bring them back into the game as anything over 175 could be tricky batting last on this pitch. Australia will want to roll over the remaining wickets quickly but Cook and an in-form de Kock are standing in their way. Should be a cracking fourth day tomorrow. Join us at 0900 IST for all the fun. Goodbye!

Earlier in the day, Australia's lower order led by a Starc blitzkrieg ensured that the lead was propelled above the 120-run mark. Khawaja couldn't add much to his overnight score but it was a marathon effort nevertheless. The Australians showed great intensity with the ball and made the Proteas work hard for each run. The final light session proved challenging once again as four wickets fell, leaving SA in a hole.

Another day to Australia and the hosts are sitting pretty in this Test match at the moment. All the pacers were brilliant, Starc in particular while Lyon produced a scintillating performance that included two late blows in the day to stun the tourists. Cook has stood tall amidst the ruins around him with a nervy yet gritty fifty. Amla got a start but couldn't convert while the others haven't rose to the occasion.
Cracker to end the day! De Kock is clueless to the off break and is beaten all ends up on the push. What a finish to the day! THAT SHALL BE STUMPS ON DAY 3.
And again! Floated on a length around off, de Kock is comprehensively beaten by the off break once more.
Gets a ripper first ball! Turn and bounce. The off break kicks up and spins across past de Kock's outside edge. It's all happening out there for the offie.
QUINTON DE KOCK walks out to bat.

OUT! LYON HAS ANOTHER! Oh boy, what a finish to the day this is turning out to be for Australia. Floated around middle, turns in to rap Abbott on the front pad. Massive lbw appeal and it's given by the umpire. SA have no reviews left and so that's another blow to the tourists. Looked close to the naked eye anyway. Lead is now 70.
Flatter on off, goes back to flick but misses as the ball hits him on the thigh pad.
Floated on leg stump, blocked off the front foot to the leg side.
Full and outside off, pushed firmly towards point.
Cracking ball! Starc is bending his back. Back of a length outside off, kept coming in with the angle and Cook just managed to evade it.
Short of a length outside off, Cook camps back and blocks it.
Full and wide outside off, Cook reaches out to that one and eases it through cover for a brace.
Sprayed on the pads, Cook clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
RIPPER! Good length angled in from outside off, Cook pushes at it but is beaten as the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Virtually unplayable stuff.
Floated outside off, Abbott defends it solidly from the crease.
Flighted outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
The nightwatchman, KYLE ABBOTT walks out to bat.

OUT! GOT HIM! Lyon nips out a vital strike at the fag end of the day. Floated outside off, not really a wise shot from Bavuma as he goes for an expansive sweep shot. The ball lobs high to the left of Wade. Smith from first slip runs across to his left to take it. The appeal for a catch is given by the umpire. Bavuma decides to review it after a chat with Cook. Hot Spot detects a slight top edge after which the ball hit the forearm before lobbing up in the air. So, the on-field call stays and South Africa have lost half their side now. Lead is 66.
Bavuma has been caught in the leg slip region. He opts for the review. Looked like he had gloved it.
Tossed up outside off, lunges into it to block but it goes off the inside half towards the leg side.
Floated on off, Bavuma hangs back and blocks it solidly.
Low full toss outside off, Cook reaches out and drills it through the covers. Won't get a boundary but will get three more.
Low full toss outside off, punchy drive towards Lyon at point.
Very full on middle, curving in at 145.8 kph, Bavuma clips it towards fine leg for a brace.
Good length outside off, seaming away, left alone.
Full and wide outside off, Cook squeezes it past point for a run.
Drifting on the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for a single.
Good length outside off, Bavuma leaves it alone to the keeper.
Floated around off, Cook works it with the turn towards short leg.
Quicker ball on a length on leg stump, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Cook reaches out to that one and defends it well.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and smothers it to the pitch.
Floated on a length on off, blocked well off the back foot down the track.
NATHAN LYON is back on.
Length ball down the leg side, Bavuma misses the flick.

FOUR! AND AGAIN! Another top edge! Bavuma tries another pull but once again gets the top edge. Thicker this time and the ball goes well over Wade to the fence. Starc has a wry smile on his face but surely this is frustrating him.
FOUR! BAVUMA LIVING DANGEROUSLY! Short ball on middle, Bavuma swivels to pull and gets a top edge on to his helmet before the ball lobs just over a leaping first slip to the fence.
Good length on off, defends it solidly off the front foot to the covers.
Back of a length outside off, Bavuma goes for a slash cut but misses.
FOUR! Streaky runs! Shortish and wide outside off, Bavuma chases it with a poke. Gets a thick edge that flies between point and gully as the ball races to the ropes.
Full and around off, driven firmly towards mid off.
Full and shaping in from around off, driven firmly towards mid on. Bird has overstepped.
Back of a length on off, tucked off the back foot to the leg side.
Fullish outside off, fluent drive from Cook but straight to cover.
Good length outside off, Cook lifts his bat to make the leave.
Back of a length on off, worked off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, blocked off the back foot towards cover.
Short of a length around off, blocked off the back foot to cover-point.
Overpitched outside off, angling in, Bavuma leans into it and creams it through extra cover for a couple.
Good length on off, blocked from the crease to the off side.
Length ball on leg stump, tucked off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length on off, blocked solidly from the crease to the off side.
Fuller outside off, Cook pushes it towards cover-point where Lyon is slow to reach the ball. Lets it through to the deep for a couple.
Fullish ball outside off, Bavuma leans into it and creams it through the covers for a brace.
Back of a length on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball outside off, defends it nicely off the front foot.
Good length just outside off, no shot offered to that one.
FOUR! Off the edge but gets through. Full and wide outside off, swinging away, Cook drives away from the body and gets a thick edge just past square gully to the third man fence for a boundary.
Length ball closer to off, defended solidly off the back foot on to the pitch.
Short of a length outside off, Bavuma is in two minds whether to play or leave. Gets a bottom edge towards second slip on the bounce.
Yorker just around off, pacy delivery, Bavuma does well to dig it out.
Short of a length outside off, Bavuma cuts but straight towards Handscomb at gully.
Short of a length on off, Bavuma stands tall and blocks it.
Good length angled away outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length slanting across the right-hander. Bavuma lets it pass.
Length ball around off, Cook hangs back and blocks it on to the track.
Full and curving into Bavuma from middle stump, he covers the swing and tucks it to mid-wicket. Single taken.
Good length around leg stump, Cook misses the flick but the ball rolls off the pads behind square. They take a leg bye.
Lovely bowling! Good length closer to off, shapes away late as Cook pokes at it loosely. Whizzes past the edge.
Length ball outside off, shaping away, left alone to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Cook hangs back and defends it firmly to short cover.
Good length on middle and off, blocked solidly from the crease.
STARC IS ON FIRE! Back of a length around off, shoots off the deck to zip past Bavuma's outside edge as he looks to fend. He got squared up completely.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Beaten again! This is superb bowling. Good length outside off, draws Bavuma into a tentative poke and beats the edge once more.
Ripper! Length ball around off, angled away with extra bounce. Bavuma plays inside the line and is beaten comfortably.
TEMBA BAVUMA comes out to bat. He has played crisis knocks already in this series. Can he do it again?

OUT! FAF DEPARTS! Starc deals a big blow to SA. Full and angled away from outside off, Faf drives away from his body and gets a thick edge that is snapped up sharply by Handscomb at gully. Huge moment in this match as the SA skipper was once again looking in good touch. Will this open the floodgates for Australia? SA lead by 30.
Beauty! Fuller outside off, shaping away, Cook chases it with a loose push and is beaten.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans into it and drives it towards mid on.
Too straight from Bird and Cook clips it down to fine leg for a brace.
Very full and outside off, dug out towards the covers.
Good length around off, blocked off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, shaping away, Cook leaves it alone.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Dug in short on middle and leg, Faf rocks back quickly and nails the pull through mid-wicket. That sped away to the ropes in a jiffy.
Sprays it far too wide outside off, easy leave for Faf.
Good length around off, Faf plays it with an angled bat towards gully.
Good length on off, Faf gets forward and blocks it well.
Good length just outside off, Faf makes a watchful leave to that one.
Fuller on leg stump, Faf gets across and tucks it towards square leg.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
Nicely bowled! Good length outside off, Cook pushes at it but is beaten by the away movement.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and blocks it.
Length ball outside off, Cook stays back and blocks it.
Length ball outside off, Cook hangs back and defends it well.
FOUR! Top shot! Fuller on middle, Cook shuffles across and tucks it through mid-wicket as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Good length around off, Cook gets back and blocks it out.
Drinks break.....
Fuller and closer to off, tidy lines and well left by Faf too.
Shortish on leg stump, Cook tries to handle the rising ball but it flies off the glove down towards fine leg. Good running gives them three.
Good length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length on off, Cook is squared up a bit on the push as the ball goes off the outer edge to point. Single taken.
Length ball around off, nips in to rap Cook on the thigh. The ball rolls to the slip cordon. Needless direct hit at the striker's end but he is well in.
Good length outside off, blocked off the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! HIGH QUALITY SHOT! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Faf leans into it and creams it through extra cover for a boundary. Nobody really budged as that rocketed to the fence in no time.
Fuller and tailing into the pads, clipped away but straight to mid-wicket.
Good length around off, good channel from Bird but Faf is equal to the task with the forward press.
Fuller on off, shaping away, Faf pushes at it as the ball goes off the outer half to cover.
Full and around off, tails in sharply, blocked well off the front foot.
Good length outside off, shaping away a bit, left alone.
JACKSON BIRD comes back on for another spell.
Back of a length on off, Cook camps back and defends it on to the track.
Length ball outside off, leans into it and pushes it towards cover.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Faf looks to control the pull and gets a top edge. Well short of the man at fine leg. Single taken.
Length ball just outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller around off, bunted firmly back to the bowler.
Good length around off, tails in sharply,  Cook pushes at it but gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Loopy outside off, Faf leans into it and defends it out.
Flighted on middle, Faf gets well forward and smothers it.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans forward and works it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter outside off, Cook doesn't offer a stroke to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Floated outside off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Good length around off, Faf pushes at it but gets it off the inside edge on to the pads.
Dug in short around off, Faf evades the bumper.
Fuller on off, shaping in, Faf blocks it off the inside half towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, another leave from Faf. This is a really probing spell from Hazlewood.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Short ball on off, Faf ducks under the bumper.
Floated around off, blocked well from the crease.
Off the edge! Floated around off, Faf pushes hard at it but gets the edge just past slip towards third man. Three runs to the total.
FAF DU PLESSIS walks out to the middle. He is greeted by boos, as was the case in the first innings too. Then he got a ton, can he do it again? SA need it.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! What a strike for Australia! Slider around off, Duminy sits back and tries to work it across the line but it skids off the deck to disturb the timber. The off stump has been ripped out! Wrong shot selection to be honest especially considering that Lyon was getting some purchase. JP knows it too and is disappointed as he makes the walk back. Timely strike for the Aussies. Lead is 7.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered to that one.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Dragged short outside off, JP stays back to that one and punches it sweetly through point to find the fence. Beautiful stroke.
Floated outside off, pushed off the front foot towards point.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Length ball outside off, gets behind the line and dabs it towards point.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans into it and pushes it through cover for a brace. Nicely timed.
Full and on off, shapes in, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller on middle, tails in, jammed towards mid on.
Almost a chance! Good length around off, nips in sharply to rap Cook on the thigh. Just short of Khawaja at gully but no bat involved.
Floated outside off, JP reaches out and jabs it to point.
Fuller around off, blocked off the front foot towards cover.
A touch short outside off, it's there to be put away but JP's cut finds point.
Floated wide outside off, JP presses forward and blocks.
Loopy on a length outside off, Duminy gets back to block as the ball goes off the outer half to gully.
Floated around off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Length ball outside off, Cook reaches out and jabs it towards gully.
Short of a length on off, Cook goes back on his toes to fend it on to the track.
Length ball around off, nips in sharply, Cook gets a thick inside edge to mid-wicket.
Length ball around off, nips in sharply, Cook gets a thick inside edge to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, nipping in, Cook gets right behind the line and blocks it.
Good length around off, defends it well from the crease.
Flighted ball on the stumps, JP covers the line and blocks it.
Flatter outside off, Duminy sits back and chops it behind point for a brace. SA HAVE TAKEN THE LEAD.
Floated outside off, JP looks to cut but cannot beat point.
Almost a return catch. Fuller outside off, JP looks to dig it out and nearly lobs it straight back at Lyon. Just short of the bowler.
Floated outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Flatter on middle, bounces a bit extra to rap Duminy on the thigh pad.
Good length outside off, Cook defends it solidly from the crease.
Length ball outside off, defends it well from the crease.
Length ball outside off, nips in sharply with bounce to rap Cook on the glove towards point.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Length ball around off, Cook looks to block as the ball rolls off the outer half towards point.
Good length outside off, Cook hangs back and dabs it towards point.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD is back on.
Drifting in on middle and leg, Cook stays back and works it with the turn past leg gully for a run.
Floated on off, Cook defends it well from the crease.
Flatter outside off, Cook stays back and blocks.
Floated around off, spins in to rap Cook on the front pad. Loud lbw appeal but the inside edge saves him.
Floated on middle and leg, Cook gets across and clips it to the leg side.
Floated on middle and leg, blocked well from the crease.
Short ball outside off, Duminy makes a leave.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Short and wide outside off, Duminy rocks back and cuts it fiercely through point. Aerial shot but also in the gap as he was in total control. Tremendous stroke.
Dug in short on middle and leg, JP ducks under the bumper.
Fulish on leg stump, Duminy gently taps it towards mid on.
Short leg comes in.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards point.
Good length on middle and off, extra bounce as it hits JP high on the bat as he looks to flick.
On a length outside off, Duminy dabs it to point for a single.
Flatter outside off, defended off the back foot.
2nd Test fifty for Cook.
Loopy on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single. It's been a gritty innings so far but he needs to carry on.
Loopy on middle and leg, Cook stays back and dabs it to short leg.
Fuller on middle, defended well off the front foot.
Floated on leg stump, Cook gets across to flick as the ball lobs to forward short leg. Appeal for a catch but no bat involved. Too high as well for the lbw.
Full and wide outside off, dug out to point.
Mistimed but in the gap. Dug in short around off, JP goes for the pull but skews it just between mid-wicket and mid on. Brace added.
Full and around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Full ball outside off, Duminy leans into it and creams it through the covers. Timed well and even Warner cannot get to it as it speeds to the fence.
Full and on off, tails in, JP blocks it well.
Good length around off, nipping in, JP looks to block but gets an inside edge on to the thigh.
Loopy outside off, tries the shot again but this time towards backward point for a run.
A touch short outside off, JP sits back and glides it towards third man for a couple.
Drifting in from outside off, pushed from the crease to cover.
Flighted outside off, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Flighted outside off, reaches out to that one and defends it well.
Tossed up outside off, leans into it and blocks it towards short cover.
Short and wide outside off, asking to be hit but Cook cannot the cut past point.
Dug in short around off, Cook drops his wrists to sway away from the line.
Short of a length outside off, Cook hops across to fend it towards cover-point.
Good length on off, Cook blocks it by closing the bat face a bit early. The inside edge goes towards short leg.
Pitched up outside off, Cook blocks it firmly towards cover.
Full and outside off, defended well off the front foot by Cook.
Shortens the length a bit around off, blocked firmly off the back foot.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Floats it up around off, JP presses forward to nudge it to point.
Loopy closer to off, Duminy pushes at it as the ball goes off the outer half to point.
Flighted around off, blocked off the front foot to the covers.
Slips it down the leg side, Duminy misses the sweep. Good stop by Wade.
NATHAN LYON comes back on. So, the Warner experiment lasts just the single over.
Short of a length around off, Cook gets right behind the line and blocks.
Fullish around off, firmly driven towards to the right of mid on for a quick single.
Back of a length outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Fuller and outside off, Cook reaches out to ease it through the covers for a run.
Shortish on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Fuller on middle and leg, pushed firmly towards mid on.
MITCHELL STARC to bowl from the other end.
Seems like a streaker has gatecrashed into the field. The security personnel is out to take him away. The man refuses to budge and is literally lifted off the field. Whoa, that's some passion!
Length ball outside off, defends it well from the crease.
Good length down the leg side, Duminy misses the flick.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball on the pads, Cook shuffles to clip it through mid-wicket for another brace.
Good length outside off, steered through point for a brace.
Good length on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.

Welcome back for the final session. The lights have taken full effect at the Adelaide Oval. Deficit is 24 with eight wickets in the tank. Evenly poised at the moment. A couple of wickets quickly or a solid partnership can shift the momentum either way. DAVID WARNER to start proceedings after dinner. Strange call, let's see how it goes.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 3.....

Hazlewood and Bird were brilliant with the ball although the latter has unfortunately not taken a wicket yet. Starc provided the customary early strike to give the hosts momentum. The deficit for South Africa is just 24 but Australia will want them to work hard for every run. The game is in the balance at the moment although Australia psychologically still are slightly on top due to the lead. The vital night session is coming up shortly. Join us for it.

Decent session for South Africa. It started horribly for the visitors as Elgar departed in the very first over. However, Cook dug in with a determined Amla as the pair stitched a valuable stand to put the innings on track. The latter was lucky to be dropped but he didn't capitalize on it as he fell to Hazlewood for the fifth time in as many innings in the series. Cook has stayed put and along with Duminy, prevented further damage.
Shortish outside off, Duminy rocks back and cuts it hard to Warner to point. He hurls in a quick throw at the bowler's end. THAT WILL BE DINNER ON DAY 3!
Quicker on the stumps, Duminy hangs back and keeps it out.
Flatter one on off, Duminy puts his head down and defends it solidly.
Fullish on leg stump, defended nicely.
On the pads, JP stays back and defends.
Back of a length outside off, Duminy stays back and defends it towards point.
LYON is back on.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

FOUR! STREAKY RUNS! Bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty, nips away after pitching. Cook comes forward and pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge that falls short of the diving Smith at second slip. Beats him to run through to the boundary.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Short of a length on middle and off, Cook pulls it through backward square leg for a couple. Played that one nicely.
Cook presses forward and defends it nicely.

THAT WAS BEAUTIFULLY BOWLED! Bowls a fullish delivery around off, swirling back in sharply. Cook goes across and gets into an uncomfortable position. Misses the line of the ball and is rapped on the pads. Huge appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Jackson has a look at Smith and the skipper thins about the review but decides against it. Good call to not take the review as it would have slipped down leg.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single
Shortish delivery that is well directed. It's rising up on Cook. He rides the bounce and keeps it down on the leg side.
Short of a length on off, Stephen hangs back and defends it nicely.
Full ball on middle, Cook drives it nicely down the ground. Warner from mid on charges in, puts in a dive but the ball goes through. Couple taken!
On a length outside off, left alone by Cook.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Straying on the pads, Cook is well balanced and clips it nicely through backward square leg and the ball races to the fence.
In between full and good length outside off, angling away and drawing Duminy into the drive. He obliges and drives on the up but gets beaten. Good testing line and length from Bird.
On a length outside off, Duminy covers the line and defends it into the off side.
Back of a length ball angling across the southpaw. He hangs back and plays it with an angled bat towards point.
Stays back to the length delivery and defends it stoutly down the track.
Fuller length ball around off, driven to mid off.
Gets this to angle away from off, Duminy shuffles across and lets it go.
Short of a length outside off, Cook camps back and defends it to the off side.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Fullish outside off, driven through cover-point.

THAT'S A PEACH! Back of a length ball outside off, swerving back sharply. Cook is cut into two halves and looks to defend but the ball hits him on the back thigh and goes through to the keeper. He lobs the ball in the air and has the crowd interested. The Aussies appeal but pull out of it quickly. Replays show there was no bat on that one.
Cook gets behind this one and defends it to the covers.
On a length outside off, shapes away after pitching. Cook goes back and leaves it alone.
On a length outside off, Duminy shoulders his arms to let that through.
Short cover in place now.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Fullish ball outside off, driven to the covers.

FOUR! BEAUTIFUL SHOT! Bowls a fuller length ball wide outside off, Duminy puts a big stride forward and drives on the up and the ball races to the fence. Warner dives athletically to his right at extra cover but couldn't reach it.
On a length angling across Duminy. He hangs back and defends it nicely to the covers.
Short of a length ball around off, played off the back foot to point.
Fuller length ball outside off drawing Duminy into the drive. He obliges but gets an inside edge to mid-wicket. Single taken!
On a length and on the stumps, Duminy has to play at that one but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, another left alone.
This time it angles away wider and Duminy is watchful as he makes another leave.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Fullish ball angling across Duminy. He leaves it alone.
Wide outside off, Cook does not flirt with it.
Similar length delivery, defended stoutly.
Short of a length on off, Cook hangs back and defends nicely.
Cook comes forward and pushes it to the covers.
Short of a length delivery, Cook hangs back and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
JP DUMINY comes to bat.

OUT! HAZLEWOOD STRIKES! He has become a bunny of Hazlewood now. On a length outside off angling in at first but straightens a touch to get Amla into a bit of a tangle. He has no choice but to play at it and gets a faint nick onto his back pad and flies towards the keeper. He takes a regulation catch. Amla goes for the review straightaway. Hotspot spots just a faint nick on the bat and that's enough. The on-field call stays and Amla has to depart. It was a good knock but falls to a beauty! South Africa trail by 42.
Amla has been given out caught behind and he has taken a review straightaway. Has he got an inside edge or not?
Similar length delivery, angling in. Amla gets behind it and defends it towards mid off.
Length delivery just outside off, Amla covers his off pole and lets it through.
On a length angling into off stump, Amla covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Fullish delivery outside off, Amla doesn't flirt with that one.
Fullish ball around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Hazlewood into the attack. Amla pulled off very late there. A bird just flew across and he got distracted.
Back of a length outside off, Cook hangs back and pushes it to point.
Angling into the leg stump, Stephen goes across and tickles it down to fine leg for a couple.
Back of a length outside off, Cook hops back and keeps it down.
FUller length ball, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
On a length and straighter this time, Cook is right behind it and blocks it.
Back of a length outside off, Cook camps back and punches it to mid on.
BIRD is back on.
Shortish delivery on the body, Amla gets into an uncomfortable position and fends it off.
FOUR! AMAZING SHOT! Back of a length outside off, Amla gets on top of it and thrashes it through cover-point for a beautiful boundary. Sheer authority on that stroke!
On a similar length outside off, angling away. Amla leaves it alone.
On a length wide outside off, Amla does not flirt with it,.
WELL PLAYED! Bowls a sharp bouncer at 140.3 clicks on middle, Amla sways away from the line nicely and leaves it with good technique. Great way to leave the short delivery!
Fuller length ball outside off, Amla leans forward and drives it firmly to the covers.
No ball! Cook plays it with soft hands to mid-wicket and scurries through for a brisk single. Starc overstepped on that occasion.
Amla plays it with the spin to mid-wicket.
SIX! SUPERB FROM AMLA! Bowls ia loopy ball on middle, Amla leans forward and lofts it down the ground and the ball just clears the fence. He is looking ominous now!
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Tosses it up outside off, Amla comes forward and drives it through the covers and the ball races to the fence.
Quicker outside off, defended solidly off the back foot the covers.
On a length again, spinning back on the stumps. Amla rocks back and cuts it to point.
On a length and spinning down leg, Amla looks to work it through but misses.
Almost a yorker length ball around off, dug out nicely to the covers.
Cook gets right behind the length delivery and defends it down the track stoutly.
Short of a length outside off, played to point.
Back of a length angling away from Cook. He stays back and pushes at it tamely but gets beaten.
Nicely played! Bowls it on a length on middle and off, Amla is well balanced as he clips it expertly through mid-wicket. Three runs taken!
On a length and wide outside off, left alone.
Full ball around off, dug out to mid-wicket.
Tosses it around off, turning in. Amla kneels and goes for the sweep but misses and the ball hits his forearm and beats the keeper. Three leg byes signaled.
Cook camps back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Seeing Cook get across his stumps, Lyon bowls it flatter on the stumps, he manages to clip it away. Risky way to play!
Cook shuffles across and defends it with the spin to short leg.
Back of a length outside off, spinning back sharply. Amla works it through square leg for a run.
Straying on the hips, nudged down to fine leg for a run.
Fuller length on the stumps, driven to mid on.
Dug in short outside off, Amla sways away from the line.
FOUR! THAT'S CRASHED! Bowls it short and wide outside off, Amla camps back and cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary.
50-run partnership up for Cook and Amla.
FOUR! SHOT! Length ball angling across Amla. He strides forward and plays a punchy drive through the covers. Sweet timing on that one and the ball races to the fence.
Back of a length on the stumps, Amla stands tall and pushes it to the covers.
Tossed up around off, Cook comes down the track and chips it uppishly to deep mid-wicket. Couple taken!
Tossed up outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
FOUR! WELL PLAYED! Cook uses his feet to the loopy ball around off and clips it beautifully through mid-wicket for a superb boundary.
Cook presses forward and defends it nicely.
Amla camps back and works it with the spin to the leg side for a single.
Cook waits for it and turns it to square leg for a single.
Full ball on the stumps, dug out down the ground for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

That's a massive miss and how costly would it prove to be? Length ball around off, angling across Amla. He with minimal foot movement pushes hard at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies towards Renshaw at first slip. He reacts late and just manages to get a hand to it and drops it. Amla gets a reprieve! Two runs taken!
Back of a length delivery directed at the body, Amla rides the bounce and tucks it to mid-wicket.
In the channel outside off, angling away. Amla points his bat skywards and lets it go.
On a length wide outside off, left alone by Amla.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
Drinks time at the Adelaide Oval.
Flatter outside off, defended well off the back foot to the off side.
Drifting in on middle and leg, swept away behind square for a single.
Drifting in from around off, defended well from the crease.
Floated on leg stump, blocked off the back foot to short leg.
On a length on off, defended off the back foot down the track.
A touch short outside off, cut away off the back foot to point where Renshaw makes a good diving stop.
Good length outside off, shaping away, Cook defends it solidly from the crease.
Pitched up outside off, Amla gets forward and eases it through cover for a single.
Fuller on off, Amla plays it around his front pad.
Fuller outside off, Amla leans forward and blocks it.

FOUR! FLASHES AND FLASHES HARD! Short of a length outside off, Amla slashes at it as the slice flies over gully to the third man fence for a boundary. It didn't come off the meat but was a percentage shot nevertheless.
Good length closer to off, Amla stays in the crease and blocks it. Bird has overstepped.
Length ball on middle and leg, Amla shuffles and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to short leg.

FOUR! TOP EDGE BUT SAFE! Floated on off, Cook goes for the sweep but gets it off the top edge. Square leg is up and this goes well over the infield towards the fence. Lyon and Australia won't mind this at all. There was risk in the shot.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Floated on a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to point. Single taken.
Flatter on leg stump, blocked off the back foot to short leg.
Flighted on off, Cook shuffles and clips it just past short leg. Single. It was in the air but flew very fast through the legs of the short leg fielder.
NATHAN LYON comes on to bowl.
Back of a length on middle, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on leg stump, shuffles across and clips it towards short mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and outside off, swinging away, too wide to make the batsman play.
Good length on off, driven off the front foot towards mid on.
Good length outside off, shaping away, Amla doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Fuller outside off, Cook drives it firmly to the covers.
Full and on off, Cook leans forward and drives it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, shaping away,  Cook makes a leave to that one.
Good length outside off, Cook doesn't offer a shot to that one.
Fuller outside off, Cook leans into it and defends it well.
Good length angled in around off, Cook hangs back and defends it solidly.
Length ball outside off, Amla stays back and defends it well.
Good length outside off, tapped off the back foot towards point.
Good length on middle, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Dug in short on off, Cook ducks under the bumper quickly.
Length ball on off, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Good length on off, Cook shuffles across and blocks.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! FINE SHOT! Full ball outside off, Amla gets forward and drives it sweetly past mid off as the ball races to the fence for a boundary. That shot should give him a lot of confidence.
Full and outside off, Amla leans forward and defends it well.
Short mid-wicket comes in. Square leg is in a catching position too.
Fuller on middle and leg, tucked behind square for a single.
Length ball outside off, Cook leans into it and defends it.
Good length closer to off, Cook defends it well from the crease.
Fuller on the pads, Cook clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Cook hangs back and defends it solidly.
Full and outside off, Cook leans into it and defends it well.
Length ball well outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Full and closer to off, defended well off the front foot.
Yorker around off, Cook does well dig it out.
Length ball angled in on off, Cook clips it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball around off, Cook gets across and defends it well.
Fuller outside off, shapes in as Cook looks to block. Gets it off the inside half to mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Good length on off, Cook shuffles across and defends it on to the track.
HAZLEWOOD has a change of ends.
Length ball closer to off, well left by Amla.
Fuller on off, Amla drills straight back to Bird who makes a good stop. The ball hits the stumps but Cook was in.
Good length on off, defended well from the crease.
Length ball outside off, shaping away, Cook stays tall and pushes it through point. Good stop near the ropes as the batsmen get three more.

That was close! Good length just around off, nips in to ping Cook on the front pad as the ball goes through to Wade. Huge lbw appeal but turned down. Impact marginally outside the line perhaps. Was there an inside edge? Replays show that there wasn't and yes, impact was just outside. Good decision.
Good length outside off, left alone to the keeper.
JACKSON BIRD comes on to bowl.
Back of a length around off, Amla lifts his bat to make the leave.
Dug in short on off, Amla sways away from the bumper.
Good length speared away outside off, Amla lets it through.
Good length angled away from just outside off, good leave from Amla.
Good length around off, nips in a bit, Amla adjusts to tap it towards the bowler.
Good length well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Length ball well outside off, Cook lets it pass.
Good length on middle, Cook gets across and jams it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball on leg stump, Amla nudges it towards mid on for a single.
Full and on off, Amla shuffles to flick but misses as it slides down the leg side. Good take by Wade behind the sticks.
Length ball well outside off, Amla shoulders arms to that one.
Amla seems to have broken his willow. He has a change of bat.
Good length outside off, awkwardly blocked from Amla as the ball hits him high on the bat.
FOUR! Tucked away! Fuller on the pads, Cook shuffles and clips it through square leg to find the fence. Too straight from Starc and Cook was quick to put it away.
Back of a length on off, Cook fends it from the crease.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Shortish on off, Cook shuffles across and fends it towards point.
Very full and outside off, Cook fails to dig it out.
Length ball outside off, defended from the crease towards extra cover.
Peach! Good length outside off, shapes away late to beat the outside edge. Amla is very lucky not to nick that.
Good length outside off, another leave from Amla.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Full and outside off, Amla gets the stride forward and pushes it to cover.
Length ball just outside off, a bit of nip in, Amla lets it pass.
Good length on middle, worked off the back foot to the leg side.
Length ball angling across Cook, too wide to make him play.
Short of a length on leg stump, fended off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Fullish outside off, Cook digs it out to the off side.

Fires in a yorker around leg stump, Cook fails to dig it out but is rapped on the boot as the ball rolls down to fine leg. Huge lbw appeal but turned down. Starc thinks of reviewing it but Smith isn't sure. Looked like missing leg, yes replays confirm it. Pitched outside leg too. A couple of leg byes taken.
Length ball outside off, Cook shuffles and pushes it through cover for a brace.
Fullish outside off, a bit of away swing, Amla eases it to cover for a single.

Full and tailing in from around off, Cook gets his bat down just in time to pat it to cover. Stifled lbw appeal from the Aussies as they think it's pad first. Nothing from the umpire. No review taken either. Replays show that it was bat first.
Beautifully bowled! Length ball outside off, moves away late as Cook is beaten on the poke.
Good length closer to off, blocked well off the back foot.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller and on leg stump, Cook flicks but straight to mid-wicket.
Good length around off, nipping in sharply, Cook looks to block but gets a faint inside edge on to the thigh pad.
JOSH HAZLEWOOD to share the new ball.
Full and closer to off, Amla presses forward and blocks it.
HASHIM AMLA walks out to bat. He's been in horrible form on this tour. If there is a time for him to step up, this is it.

OUT! STARC DRAWS FIRST BLOOD! What a start for Australia! Fullish and angled in closer to off, squares up Elgar as the outside edge flies to second slip. Smith, stationed there, takes a very good diving catch to his left. South Africa have been rocked early as Elgar goes for a duck.
Fuller around off, tails in a bit, pushed gently towards mid on.
Good length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Good length on leg stump, Cook shuffles and rides the extra bounce with a nervy tuck to square leg. Single taken.
Good length well wide outside off, shaping away but too wide to make Cook play.
